lines: Five things everyone believes about buying a home.
Only one of them is true.
Guess before I tell you... and keep score.
One. Renting is throwing money away.
Myth.
Rent buys you flexibility... and zero repair bills.
Owners pay interest, taxes and maintenance. Money they never get back either.
Two. The asking price is the final price.
Myth.
Price, closing date, even the appliances... almost everything is negotiable.
Three. Pre-construction is always cheaper.
Myth.
It can be cheaper on paper... but you're paying for something that doesn't exist yet.
Delays and changes are your risk.
Four. Location matters more than the house.
Fact.
You can remodel a kitchen... you can't move the house.
Five. Fresh paint means the house is in great shape.
Myth.
Sometimes fresh paint is hiding moisture. We made a whole video about it.
How many did you get right? Comment your score... and follow before you buy anything.
